name: What is considered a first-time home buyer?

mainEntity.name: What is considered a first-time home buyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generally, a first-time home buyer is someone who has not owned a home in the last three years. This definition is used by many assistance programs, including those offered at the state and federal level. Even if you've owned a property before, you might still qualify if you haven't held ownership for a specific period, often three years. Understanding this definition is key as it determines your eligibility for various first-time home buyer benefits.
